incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Metering anomaly detected. Token aggregation delta >10% vs baseline for the current billing window. Delayed usage emits and several overage flags triggered. Paging: @ryan @maria-billing. Auto-silence window: 30m.
ryan: Oncall here — joining. Can someone paste the quick query results? Any evidence of customer-facing billing spikes yet?
maria-billing: Early recon: 14 customers have overage flags in the last 2h; amounts look inflated. Running a quick aggregate:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum, COUNT(*) as events
FROM metering.emits
WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY tokens_sum DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
sample output: (redacted)
- cust_42: tokens_sum=1,240,312 events=3  
- cust_18: tokens_sum=803,120 events=2
- cust_7: tokens_sum=90,004 events=1
Weird that events are very low but tokens_sum huge — suggests bad aggregation duplication or bad token size field.
sasha: I see a correlated spike on emitter-processor (kafka consumer) retries starting at 3400009000. Logs show repeated re-processing of the same offset range. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-14T12:35:22Z] emitter-processor INFO replaying offsets 12345-12360 for shard s-3
[2026-03-14T12:35:23Z] emitter-processor WARN duplicate emit detected id=abcd1234
[2026-03-14T12:35:24Z] emitter-processor INFO acked offset 12346
```
Looks like the consumer was stuck then restarted and replayed, but dedupe layer failed to drop duplicates for a subset of messages (token payload differs slightly in token_count metadata).
amy-support: Support: we've got ~6 open tickets saying "billing spike" and one customer asked for invoice hold. Preparing a short status note. Do we need to open a customer-facing incident?
ryan: Yes — tag prod-impact. Maria, can we temporarily suppress automatic overage emails/flags to customers while we triage? We should avoid charging for duplicates.
maria-billing: I can flip a mitigation flag that suppresses overage notifications and prevents automated crediting rules from running. Command: 
```bash
# temporary mitigation - suppress overage flags for emitted window
redwoodctl billing flags set suppress_overage_notifications=true --scope=global --expires=30m
```
Applying now. Will also create a manual ledger to avoid automated charges.
deploy-bot: job=billing-flag-toggle user=maria-billing status=started ts=3400012520
deploy-bot: job=billing-flag-toggle status=success ts=3400012530
maria-billing: Done. Overages suppressed and automated charge pipeline paused. Note: this is a mitigation only — we need to prevent double-counting in source.
sasha: Proposed short-term mitigation: enable a stricter dedupe pass in the emitter worker for last 6 hours and drop emits with identical event_id OR identical (customer_id, request_id, token_hash). Patch quick-run: 
```python
# pseudo
for evt in window:
    key = (evt.customer_id, evt.request_id)
    if seen.exists(key): continue
    write(evt)
```
I can push a hotfix to emitter-processor; will need a restart of 3 consumer pods (rolling).
ryan: Do it. But coordinate with infra — rolling restarts could slightly increase lag. Maria, keep suppression until we verify. Amy, draft the customer note: short, transparent, and mention credits are being reviewed.
amy-support: Working on note now. Draft: "We're investigating an internal metering issue that may have caused temporary billing spikes. No charges will be finalized while we investigate. We'll follow up with specifics and any credits." Want product signoff.
ted-product: LGTM, keep it short. Also prep a short FAQ for support (why did this happen, will I be charged, timeline).
sasha: Pushing emitter hotfix to staging-first: 
- build 3400013001
- smoke test on shard s-1
- rolling restart s-2 -> s-3 -> s-1
Expect ~6m per pod.
ryan: Coordinate with deploy-bot and eng-infra. I'll watch for increased retry loops.
deploy-bot: pipeline=hotfix-emitter build=3400013001 status=queued
deploy-bot: pipeline=hotfix-emitter status=running ts=3400013100
deploy-bot: pipeline=hotfix-emitter status=ok ts=3400013380
sasha: Hotfix deployed. Observability: duplicate-detected metric rate dropped to baseline within 2m. Re-run token aggregation:
```sql
-- after fix run
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum
FROM metering.emits
WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY tokens_sum DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Now see no extreme spikes; top customers within expected range.
maria-billing: Reconciler is running to backfill correct counts and clear false overage flags. Will compute delta by customer and mark credits where necessary. Running backfill job: job=ledger-reconciler ts=3400014200
maria-billing: ledger-reconciler status=partial-complete processed_customers=14 flagged_adjustments=12 ts=3400014740
amy-support: Support update: sent initial note to affected customers and added FAQ link. Escalations: 2 customers asked for immediate invoice hold which we've done.
ryan: Good. Next steps for postmortem: 1) Root cause: consumer restart + incomplete dedupe on slight payload differences 2) Action: strengthen dedupe to use token-hash, add end-to-end test to simulate replay 3) Billing: run full reconciliation, apply customer credits where needed, and revert suppression flag after verification. 4) Alerts: lower signal-to-noise threshold for duplicate-detected metric.
maria-billing: I'll generate a ledger CSV with adjustments and customer credit recommendations and share in #billing tomorrow AM. Also propose a small automation to detect token_count anomalies (>5x median) per event.
sasha: I'll add a unit/integration test and a patch to make dedupe tolerant to tiny metadata drift. PR will be linked in the postmortem.
ryan: Anyone want to add notes? Otherwise I'll close thread when monitoring is stable.
amy-support: Add note to tickets: credits will be handled automatically after reconciliation.
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigation applied, customer notifications sent. Monitoring for 1h. Incident lead=ryan. Severity=SEV3 (billing impact, mitigated).
ryan: Closing the active pager — monitoring only. Great work team. We'll open a follow-up doc for postmortem and runbook updates.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) ts=3400015745
